BindAlias.description_en: Attach an alias to a device
BindAlias.description_zh: 绑定设备和别名的关系

BindPhone.description_en: Attaches a device to a phone number
BindPhone.description_zh: 绑定设备与手机号的关系

BindTag.description_en: Binds tags to specified device targets. Tag bindings take effect within 10 minutes
BindTag.description_zh: 将TAG绑定到指定的设备目标，TAG绑定在10分钟内生效

CancelPush.description_en: Cancels a scheduled push task that has not yet been executed
CancelPush.description_zh: 取消某次尚未执行的定时推送任务

CheckCertificate.description_en: Checks the expiration time and current status of the iOS certificate for a specified app
CheckCertificate.description_zh: 检测指定app的iOS证书过期时间及当前证书状态

CheckDevice.description_zh: 验证指定设备的有效性

CheckDevices.description_en: Validate a specified group of devices
CheckDevices.description_zh: 验证指定的一组设备的有效性

CompleteContinuouslyPush.description_en: Manually ends a continuous push task
CompleteContinuouslyPush.description_zh: 手动结束持续推送任务

ContinuouslyPush.description_en: Executes a predefined continuous push task
ContinuouslyPush.description_zh: 执行预定义的持续推送任务

ListSummaryApps.description_en: Retrieve the list of all applications associated with your Alibaba Cloud account
ListSummaryApps.description_zh: 查询云账号下所有app的列表

ListTags.description_en: Queries the tags of an app. A maximum of 100 records are returned
ListTags.description_zh: 查询app的标签列表，最多返回100条记录

MassPush.description_en: Push different messages/notifications to different devices in batch
MassPush.description_zh: 批量给不同的设备推送不同的消息/通知

MassPushV2.description_en: Pushes notifications in batch by using the advanced push API V2

Push.description_en: Advanced Push API that pushes notifications or messages to different device endpoints. This API provides rich push customization parameters to implement push behavior in different scenarios
Push.description_zh: 高级推送接口，推送通知或者消息到不同设备端，本接口提供丰富的推送定制参数，以实现不同场景下的推送行为

PushMessageToAndroid.description_en: Sends a message to an Android device through the Alibaba Cloud Mobile Push proprietary channel. After the app on the device receives the message, it must handle subsequent actions, such as implementing business logic or displaying a local notification
PushMessageToAndroid.description_zh: 推送消息到Android设备端，消息通过阿里云推送自有通道下发。设备上App接收到消息后，需要自行处理后续动作，比如实现业务行为，或者构造本地通知弹出等

PushMessageToiOS.description_en: Pushes messages to iOS devices. These messages are delivered through the proprietary channel of Alibaba Cloud Mobile Push. After the app on a device receives a message, it must handle subsequent actions, such as implementing business behaviors or creating local notifications
PushMessageToiOS.description_zh: 推送消息到iOS设备端，消息通过阿里云推送自有通道下发。设备上App接收到消息后，需要自行处理后续动作，比如实现业务行为，或者构造本地通知弹出等

PushNoticeToAndroid.description_en: Sends a notification to Android devices. The notification appears directly in the device’s notification tray and may be delivered through Alibaba Cloud’s proprietary channel or the device manufacturer’s channel, depending on the scenario
PushNoticeToAndroid.description_zh: 推送通知到Android设备端，并直接在设备通知栏弹出。通知根据不同情况，可能会走阿里云自有通道，或者手机厂商通道下发

PushNoticeToiOS.description_en: Send a notification to iOS devices. The notification uses Apple’s APNs channel and appears directly in the device notification center
PushNoticeToiOS.description_zh: 推送通知到 iOS 设备端，通知通过苹果APNs通道下发，并直接在设备通知栏弹出

PushV2.description_en: Sends a push notification by using the advanced push API V2

QueryAliases.description_en: Query the list of aliases attached to a specified device
QueryAliases.description_zh: 查询指定设备绑定的别名列表

QueryDeviceInfo.description_en: Query details of a specified device
QueryDeviceInfo.description_zh: 查询指定设备详细信息

QueryDeviceStat.description_en: Queries device statistics by application dimension

QueryDevicesByAccount.description_en: Retrieve the list of devices associated with an account using the account name
QueryDevicesByAccount.description_zh: 通过账户名称查询对应的设备列表

QueryDevicesByAlias.description_en: Query the list of devices by alias
QueryDevicesByAlias.description_zh: 通过别名查询对应的设备列表

QueryPushRecords.description_en: You can query push records with pagination and basic filtering
QueryPushRecords.description_zh: 分页查询推送记录，并提供一些简单的筛选能力

QueryPushStatByApp.description_en: Query push statistics for an app

QueryPushStatByMsg.description_en: Queries push statistics for a message
QueryPushStatByMsg.description_zh: 查询消息维度的推送统计

QueryTags.description_en: Queries tags for a specified object, such as a device, account, or alias
QueryTags.description_zh: 查询指定对象（设备、账号或别名）的TAG列表

QueryUniqueDeviceStat.description_en: Obtain deduplicated device statistics for an app
QueryUniqueDeviceStat.description_zh: 查询app维度的去重设备统计

RemoveTag.description_en: Removes a tag from an app

UnbindAlias.description_en: Unbinds an alias. The change takes effect immediately
UnbindAlias.description_zh: 解绑别名，解绑立即生效

UnbindPhone.description_en: Unbind the mobile phone number from a specified device
UnbindPhone.description_zh: 解绑指定设备上已绑定的手机号码

UnbindTag.description_en: Unbinds one or more tags from a specified target
UnbindTag.description_zh: 解绑指定的TAG和其目标之间的关系
